Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
A couple of questions about the Daughters:

1) Is it still considered "during the Influence Phase" when you've brought
a vampire into play at the end? Can Angela Preston immediately tap to
use her ability?

2) If a vampire is holding onto a vote after playing Echo of Harmonies at
Superior, when she burns it to call the vote, do you gain the 1 vote
from the political action card? If not, can her controller burn a vote
card from his hand to gain a vote?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> 1) Is it still considered "during the Influence Phase" when you've brought
> a vampire into play at the end? Can Angela Preston immediately tap to
> use her ability?

Yes.

> 2) If a vampire is holding onto a vote after playing Echo of Harmonies at
> Superior, when she burns it to call the vote, do you gain the 1 vote
> from the political action card? If not, can her controller burn a vote
> card from his hand to gain a vote?

No. Yes.

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <3C7662F3...@white-wolf.com>,

LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote:
>Jozxyqk wrote:
>> 1) Is it still considered "during the Influence Phase" when you've brought
>> a vampire into play at the end? Can Angela Preston immediately tap to
>> use her ability?
>
>Yes.

Is this true? [7] states that vampires are moved into play at the _end_
of the influence phase. It appears to me that flipping the vampire
face up implicitly ends the influence phase -- meaning that Angela
Preston can't use her ability, and the additional transfers granted by
Ingrid Rossler can't be used.

Is there a post-end of influence phase window where the influence phase
has ended, but it's still the influence phase?

confused,

gomi

Ok, but if I influence up two vampires, one of which is Angela, then I
get to choose in which order I do that, and tapping may be done anytime
unless otherwise specified. After Angela comes into play, even though
that is at the end of my influencephase there still has to be some
influencephase left before vampire number two is influenced, and that
tiny timewindow ought to be enough. Cornercase, yes I know.

Sten During
